sentences.en: Extenuating circumstances led the judge to pass a more lenient sentence.
sentences.zh: 减轻处罚的情节让法官判了一个较为宽容的判决。

sentences.en: You shouldn't be lenient with those who commit crimes against humanity.
sentences.zh: 你不能对犯下反人类罪行的人过于宽容。

sentences.en: He tended to be lenient toward the children.
sentences.zh: 他通常会比较宽容地对待孩子们。
